outputs.explanation: Panel A contains an H&E micrograph and spatial gene-expression heatmap plots overlaid on tissue sections; these are heatmap-type visualizations, not averaged summary plots (e.g., bar charts), so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel B consists of H&E and RNAscope fluorescence micrographs, not a quantitative plot showing averages.
Panel C is a dot/scatter plot displaying every individual patient value (LUAD n=512, LUSC n=500) with median and 95% CI overlaid, so individual data points are already shown.
Panel D is a bar chart of mean ± SD with individual data points (dots, n=3 per group) overlaid on each bar.
